text:
deploy-bot: Canary kick: model-router v1.9.0 -> staged rollout 7% (ap-south-1: 5%, us-west-2: 2%). Change window 30m. Release notes: https://go/release/2025-04-10. Watch p50/p95/p99 + 5xx for first 12m. ID: canary-6210007777
ashley: starting active watch. thresholds: p99 +150ms or 5xx >0.8% -> pause.
jordan: noticing p99 in ap-south jumping from 210ms -> 430ms in last 6m. p95 steady. tail only.
priya: digging into traces — looks like KV cache misses spike on ap-south canary nodes right before tail. logs: ```WARN kvcache: eviction_count=42 miss_rate=0.78```
eng-release-lead: Is this limited to canary cohort or global?
jordan: isolated to canary instances in ap-south (same infra shard). baseline hosts show miss_rate ~0.12.
priya: stack shows requests hitting fallback path that forces reload of token-KV and triggers backend fetch: `kvclient.fetch(keys=...) -> timeout 200ms`
oncall-sre: Ops note: timeout to external KV backend + bursty misses can produce tail latency. Recommend pin ap-south to previous stable v1.8.7 and keep us-west progressing to 7%. Agree?
jordan: +1 pin ap-south. If we keep the canary there, we risk user-facing tail latency. Also recommend heap/profile from canary nodes.
nashley: vote: pin ap-south or full pause?
priya: +1 pin ap-south and collect profiles. I have a hypothesis: cache prewarm / new prefetch heuristic in v1.9.0 causing eviction storms on certain shard sizes.
eng-release-lead: quick vote tally: pin ap-south vs continue. Please vote by replying.
oncall-sre: +1 pin. I'll lower alert sensitivity for p95 but page if p99 >500ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: Running route-pin: `route-pin --region ap-south-1 --to v1.8.7 --weight 100% --reason "kvcache eviction spike causing p99 tail"`
deploy-bot: Route update done. ap-south now routed to v1.8.7 (approx 5% traffic). Canary continues in us-west-2 (2%). Rollout ID: canary-6210007777
jordan: collecting heap + perf maps from canary hosts now and attaching to ticket RT-3890.
priya: adding synthetic load with partner-slice to reproduce eviction storm. quick repro: run `ab -n 5000 -c 50 -H "X-Slice: partner-300" https://ap-south-1.textgen/api` and watch `kvcache.evictions` metric.
nashley: noted in release notes: pausing ap-south progression due to KV cache tail. Link: https://go/release/2025-04-10#6210007777-notes
eng-release-lead: Good. If profile confirms prefetch heuristic bug, cut a v1.9.1 revert or patch and re-roll within same window. QA & SRE, prioritize validation.
oncall-sre: I'll keep an eye on us-west-2; if similar symptoms appear we will trigger full rollback.
jordan: heap/profiles uploaded to RT-3890. Preliminary look suggests larger resident set after prefetch, then eviction flurry when background GC runs.
priya: opened PR #7301 to tweak prefetch window and add guard to avoid aggressive prefetch on small shards. running unit tests now.
nashley: will hold global progression. If PR merges and perf tests are green, we aim to resume canary by re-routing ap-south to v1.9.1 candidate.
eng-release-lead: Acknowledged. Keep updates in RT-3890. Reconvene in 20m for status.
